01 — Digital Campaign

Private
Pension Fund

Integrated campaign: social media, paid ads, landing page

Client
Gjorgjev Finance
Role
Visual Designer · Art Director
Deliverables
Social, Paid Ads, Landing Page
The Challenge

Financial products — especially pension funds — are notoriously difficult to market. The audience is disengaged, the subject is abstract, and competing for attention on social media means fighting against lifestyle content. The brief required making a complex, long-horizon financial product feel urgent, credible, and approachable to a Macedonian audience with little existing awareness.

The Approach

The campaign was built around a single guiding principle: clarity over complexity. Rather than leading with product features, the visual system led with emotional relevance — security, family, time. A structured carousel format was developed for social media, breaking the information into a logical awareness-to-action sequence. Each slide was designed to function as a standalone unit while maintaining visual cohesion across the full set.

A restrained navy-and-teal palette communicated institutional trust, while direct Macedonian-language copy ("Don't wait. The future starts today.") bypassed financial jargon in favour of clear calls to action. The landing page extended the system responsively across desktop and mobile, with a simplified lead capture form as the primary conversion goal.

Social Media Carousel — 6 Assets
Paid Ads — 3 Formats
Landing Page
Deliverables
6 social media carousel assets 3 paid ad formats Responsive landing page Awareness-to-conversion narrative
02 — Brand Identity

KraftForm

Branding Identity + Digital Campaign

A bold visual identity concept for KraftFORM®, focused on creating a strong, recognisable presence across digital and physical touchpoints. The project explores typography, color, and composition to build a cohesive and scalable brand system.

Client
KraftForm
Role
Lead Brand Designer / Digital Strategist
Year
2026
Challenge
The fitness market is saturated with generic "neon-and-black" aesthetics. KraftFORM® needed to move away from the gym stereotype and evolve into a professional training tool. The challenge was to create a visual language that felt industrial and heavy-duty while maintaining the agility needed for high-frequency social media campaigns.
Objective
The primary goal was to establish a "Work Site" brand energy — utilising high-contrast safety colors and aggressive typography. We aimed to increase brand recall through a modular grid system that allows for rapid digital asset creation without losing the premium, "engineered" feel of the core identity.
Results
The identity provided a 40% increase in content production efficiency through the use of standardised social media templates. By shifting to an industrial palette (Graphite and Safety Orange), the brand achieved a distinct visual "cutoff" from competitors, resulting in a significantly higher engagement rate on mobile-first digital campaigns.
01 Branding Identity

Designing a high-impact brand language rooted in strength and precision. Through a structured grid and a high-visibility color palette, the identity builds a scalable foundation for both physical environments and digital platforms.

02 Brand Applications

Translating the brand identity of KraftFORM® into large-scale environmental formats. By applying the characteristic architectural signage and urban advertising, we created a brand mandate to "Work Site" areas. The application showcases the flexibility of the identity system to any medium — from architectural building wraps to complex, editorial digital layouts.

03 Digital & Physical Assets

A comprehensive rollout of the KraftFORM® visual language across key digital and physical channels. This collection showcases the flexibility of the identity system, demonstrating its impact across social pages, app design, product collateral, and more. The result is a cohesive brand toolkit that is fully engineered, production-ready, and built to scale.

Complete brand identity system Logo suite + brand guidelines Social media system OOH billboard + signage Conceptual app design Membership cards + merch
03 — Packaging & Campaign

FLAPthat
JACK

Packaging design, brand identity, and social media campaign for an organic protein bar brand

Client
Biocosmos
Role
Head of Packaging Design
Deliverables
Packaging, Identity, Campaign, Social
The Challenge

Organic protein bars compete in a shelf environment where packaging must do the selling in under two seconds. FLAPthatJACK needed to appeal to a young, active, health-conscious audience while clearly communicating organic credentials and differentiating across multiple flavours. The brand also needed a social media identity that could sustain ongoing content without creative fatigue.

The Solution

The packaging system was built on bold, maximalist illustration — hand-drawn patterns covering the wrapper in high-density visual energy that signals handmade, artisan origins. The logo uses a custom display typeface with a stamp-like quality, reinforcing organic authenticity without leaning into clichéd earthy browns and greens.

Colour became the flavour differentiator: each SKU owns a distinct background colour (red for cocoa/coconut, yellow for honey/peanut butter), while the illustration pattern and logo remain consistent — creating immediate shelf variety and cohesion simultaneously. The campaign extended the visual system into Instagram stories and posts, using the flavour colours as campaign backdrops and leaning into playful copy like "Organic Energy. No Drama." and "Fuel the Day."

Deliverables
Multi-SKU packaging system Custom illustration Brand identity Social media templates OOH poster campaign Instagram Stories system
04 — Editorial Design & Branding

Skopje
Riverside

Residential development brand identity, editorial catalog, and outdoor advertising

Client
Skopje Riverside Development
Role
Brand & Editorial Designer
Deliverables
Identity, Catalog, OOH, Print
The Challenge

Residential developments typically sell apartments through floor plans and renders alone. Skopje Riverside needed to go further — positioning the development as a lifestyle destination, not just a building. The brand had to convey aspiration and permanence across a wide format range: a 60+ page editorial sales catalog, large-format OOH, bus shelter advertising, branded merchandise, and digital channels.

01 — Editorial Catalog

The sales catalog was designed with a magazine sensibility — generous white space, full-bleed photography, and a clear hierarchy guiding buyers from emotional inspiration through to technical apartment specifications. Floor plans and unit details were visually integrated rather than treated as dry technical documents, making the purchase journey feel considered at every stage.

02 — Outdoor Advertising & Print

The identity was deployed across large-format outdoor advertising and street-level placements, demonstrating the brand's range from monumental billboard presence to intimate urban touchpoints. The split-panel composition — abstract teal texture against deep navy — creates immediate visual recognition at distance while maintaining a premium, gallery-like quality up close. Branded shopping bags extended the system into a physical premium touchpoint for prospective buyers.

Deliverables
Brand identity + SR monogram 60+ page editorial catalog Large-format OOH billboard Bus shelter + indoor advertising Branded shopping bags
